process.bobFirst: npm test (this catalog + Fortune unit tests)
process.maddyAfter: Safari QA only after Bob is green

cases.title: Every board row has a date or range
cases.expect: whenLabel / date present for Fix, Stabilize, Plan, and Invest rows. Fix title stays Debt renegotiation · 3 or 6 months (calendar date is secondary, never the strong title).

cases.title: Growth-pot pin must not mutate emergency fund
cases.expect: Editing or pinning First growth pot does not change EF amount; board keeps one growth pot in Invest, not a duplicate Plan row.

cases.title: Must-fix loop: Fortune → Right Door / Sunday → Back to Fortune
cases.expect: Heavy fire link carries ?from=fortune. Header chip Back to Fortune Teller. Return lands on Me today with Looks right — open my plan. Fortune footer stays Fortune's PoC version (not Right Door v0.8.0) without a hard refresh. Board Fix is Debt renegotiation · 3 or 6 months. Live path: Safari.

cases.title: Every later open lands on Step 1 (Me today)
cases.expect: After Privacy is accepted once, every open is Step 1. Looks right — open my plan is one tap to the board; picking a card still walks Step 2. No auto-skip. Live path: Safari.

cases.title: Absurd 0 / 0 / huge house hard-fails
cases.expect: 0 income, 0 savings, HK$15M+ house: hardFail, wrecked dials, does not hold, no you're-set.

cases.title: Drag living goals in time within a stage
cases.expect: Sooner / Later (and vertical handle) update milestone.months on living goals. Stage stays put; phase end is max(months) and can extend. Fix/EF are not user-invented. Dates stay on the row. Live gesture: Safari.

cases.title: Soft phase overlap on the stage stack
cases.expect: Fix → Stabilize → Plan → Invest is priority order, not hard walls. Stabilize may start at the end of Fix; Plan/Invest months may sit inside an earlier window without changing stage. Home board stays the vertical stack — no overlapping path-pin chart. Live overlap hint: Safari.

cases.title: Fortune footer version survives Right Door / Sunday return
cases.expect: Fortune footer shows PoC v0.9.x. Open Right Door or Sunday Pack, tap Back to Fortune Teller. Fortune footer is still Fortune's version (never RD/Sunday PoC v0.8.0) without a hard refresh.
